異質 / Heterogeneity

心理雜談 純音樂

Why not take pride in your weirdness?
何不為你的怪異感到自豪？

-

《異質 / Heterogeneity 》

然而這卻不是我最怪的作品，至少對我來說。

-

【Lyrics (?】

To be or not to be
Why is that even a question?
Is it foolishness or clarity that traps one there?

What gives meaning to you?
Wealth, beauty
Is that enough?

What gives meaning to you?
Love, so intangible
Can you hold it?

What gives meaning to you?
A goal, once achieved
Will the emptiness ever fade?

What gives meaning to you?
Ordinary dreams
Do they make you who you are?

Have you ever asked yourself these things?
Do you carry an answer?

Don’t rush to deny
I’m not saying they are worthless
But what if you doubt?

When you are moved
are the ripples within you
or borrowed from others?

Is loneliness a poison?
Can one be free without belonging?

Is difference a sin?
Can one find peace without being common?

What is “Normal”?
Can anyone truly be it?

And if you are heterogeneitc
must the world refuse you?

To be or not to be
Why is that even a question?
A phrase so paradoxical
Is it worth such thought?

To be or not to be
Why is that even a question?
If no one else hesitates
Does the question still matter?

What gives meaning to you?
Wealth, beauty
Is that enough?

What gives meaning to you?
Love, so intangible
Can you hold it?

What gives meaning to you?
A goal, once achieved
Will the emptiness ever fade?

What gives meaning to you?
Ordinary dreams
Do they make you who you are?

Have you ever asked yourself these things?
So why not take pride in your weirdness?
